paras: Application: Ford Focus RS (2016-2018) EcoBoost Part Type: Fluid Lock dual (PCV and CCV) oil catch can kit Part Number: 20-0328-FL

Radium catch cans separate oil and water condensate from crankcase gases before they reach the intake, preventing oil build-up in the intake, intercooler, throttle body and intake manifold. It is a closed system, so oil vapours are kept out of the cabin. This dual kit combines the 20-0315-FL PCV kit and 20-0316-FL CCV kit to isolate both breather circuits.
hl: Fluid Lock System: Patented design prevents the reservoir overfilling and holds collected fluid until emptied
Large Ports: 10AN ORB inlet and outlet ports
O-Ring Sealed Dipstick: Check fluid level without removing the can
ft: Radium Engineering Dual Fluid Lock Catch Can Kit for Ford Focus RS LZ 2016-2017
